name: linux-r2-native
purpose: Fresh local WSL Vulkan integration of the pending R2 runtime when no matching qualified Linux SDK exists
budget_basis: Same 6 GiB as the Linux CI fresh native lease; retained run w7-lavapipe-smooth-254 used 3120334487 bytes including build and consumer environments, with 400261425 source bytes
reuse: existing locked CPython and build tools
retained exact dependency sources and original licenses without history cloning
existing software Vulkan library and ICD, selected and hashed explicitly
fresh: One registered Linux run after the Windows scratch root is empty; export the exact selected source commit and verify dependencies before and after compilation
constraints: check the guest filesystem and Windows backing volume before allocation and throughout execution
inherit the existing protected and blocked registry without replacing it
keep all compiler, uv, environment and test temporary outputs inside the selected registered run
no automatic network, source, package, driver or system-setting fallback
audit and materialize only known environment interpreter aliases before managed cleanup; unknown aliases remain refusals
retention: Retain the exact wheel, preferred first-party delta, dependency-source references and licenses, toolchain/input hashes, commands, actual exits and focused installed results in the existing Windows store
terminal_cleanup: Wait all owned children; retain failure reproducer if needed; inspect/apply the registry-bound guest cleanup plan; rehash retained files and report reclaimed bytes
scope: Local WSL software Vulkan development integration only; full mandatory-row qualification, source/admission CI and promotion remain separate; no native Linux GPU or Metal claim
